images.name: T2K-walk_a
images.prompt:
EDIT IMAGE 1 IN PLACE. Output 1536x1024. The entire empty background MUST be brilliant solid green #00FF00, exactly like Image 1 and Image 2. Keep this green visible across the entire canvas between all creatures and at all edges. This is a green-screen sprite sheet. Background RGB (0,255,0) is mandatory. Do not paint anything on the green background.
Apply the watercolor, crisp dark ink contour and fine hatching of Image 2 ONLY INSIDE the existing twelve creature silhouettes of Image 1. Image 3 supplies the calm human facial identity. Preserve all positions, silhouettes, head angles, paws, limb angles, tails and the 4x3 arrangement of Image 1 exactly. Twelve distinct walk keys, two per direction: first row south/south/north-east/north-east; second row north/north/north-west/north-west; third row west/west/south-west/south-west. The upper-right four creatures face AWAY: preserve the back-of-head visibility from Image 1, do not turn their faces into side profiles. No text, borders, ground or shadows.
Same lean ribbed blue-grey hound body, dark spine, pale belly, clawed feet, whip tail, layered mane and long blond-brown hair with a calm bearded man's face as Image 2. All frames are the SAME creature, identically painted and marked. Uneven transparent hand-painted washes, pale cream highlights, pigment pooling, granulation, dark wavering ink line and hand hatching. Moderate mineral colours, soft even upper-left daylight. No gradients or light effects anywhere.
Correction to previous attempt: its dark gradient background was incorrect; preserve original bright pure green without any change. Preserve the original away-facing head orientations. Use Image 1 as edit target, Image 2 as hand/identity reference, Image 3 as face reference.

references.role: Edit target: twelve walk poses and layout
Approved character identity and painting hand
